properties.statement:
ROUGH SIZING, and it is the number that set the build order for the requirement it hangs off.

MEASURED 2026-08-17 by comparing every property declared across `schema/*.yaml` against every parameter name any served tool accepts, read from the committed toolsnaps: 215 declared properties across 29 node types, 180 distinct tool parameter names, and 70 OF THE 215 (32%) HAVE A NAME NO SERVED TOOL ACCEPTS. Worst by count: Fragment 9/11, EnvironmentRule 7/9, Capability 6/10, Project 5/11, TemporalFact 4/8, DriftEvent 4/6, Question 4/8.

A SECOND READING FROM THE SAME SWEEP, sharper because it is exact rather than heuristic: `embedding_field` is declared 26 TIMES across 11 schema files, and NO CODE IN REFLOW2 TOUCHES EMBEDDINGS AT ALL. `dynograph-vector` is a direct dependency of reflow2-core and contributes exactly two functions, both statistics (`linear_regression_slope`, `mean`, in dimensions.rs); the entire HNSW index is unused and `search_design` is BM25 through `dynograph-text`. That is the reachability pattern one level up: not a field no tool can write, but a whole declared CAPABILITY nothing computes. Bears directly on `dec:idea-embeddings-adoption`, which is open.

⚠️ THE 32% IS AN OVERCOUNT AND MUST NOT BE QUOTED AS A DEFECT COUNT. It matches on NAME only, so it misses properties a tool sets under a different parameter name and properties written indirectly by tools like `record_change`, `reconcile_artifacts` and `link_artifact`. A live example from this same session: `TemporalFact.valid_from` appears in the unreachable list, and it IS writable — through `create_node`'s generic props, which the requirement explicitly says must NOT count as reachability.

WHY IT WAS RECORDED ANYWAY, and what it changed: the requirement as first written asked for a detector. This number says a detector run against a heuristic like this one would report dozens of findings on its first pass, most of them noise, which is how a new instrument loses its reader in one release. So the accepted build order became: draw the SPECIFIES edges, MEASURE PROPERLY AND SHOW ANTHONY, then build the detector. The rough number is the argument for not skipping the middle step, not a finding in its own right.
